reasoning.formula: For long logical axis L, reference depth n and existing relative font rank r, U=L/2^n and size=U*2^(r/2).
reasoning.gauge: Replacing n by n+1 and every role rank by r+2 leaves every font size unchanged. The reference depth and role ranks are not independently meaningful until a convention fixes one.
reasoning.example_boundary: Arithmetic examples only; depth 6 and the inherited relative ranks have not been selected or accepted. Absolute choices affect all actual type sizes.
reasoning.access: A purely viewport-derived type size does not inherently follow a separately configured browser root font size; user-controlled enlargement needs an explicit, consistent design.
reasoning.mutation_boundary: No product source, authored grid, site layout, type rank or living receptor changed.

outcome: Direction accepted and exact encounter preserved. Concrete type roles/reference and implementation remain unresolved; the current site still uses the prior rem origin.
